says: The start's per-dial map of write times gets an entry for every call and loses one only when the write fails, so a long online dial keeps one entry per call it ever made.
proof: grep -n written WindowStart.ts shows set at line 248 and delete only at 251 inside the failed-write mapError; the old start at main 60a795c56, next/packages/tuval/src/window/main.tsx, deleted the entry in answer() on every settled reply (written.delete(id)).
cost: A headless client or tab that stays online for days grows memory with each read, open and send; small per entry, unbounded over a dial.
